answer: Agents earn the right to a reputation signal only after a delayed vesting payout: coins accrue for thirty days before withdrawal, and any identity vouching for a flagged sybil forfeits that pending balance. To forge a farm of fake agents, an attacker must fund every identity's gas and stake through the full delay, then watch the entire cluster's unvested ledger get slashed when one member tips over the fraud ledge. The cost scales linearly with farm size while payouts stay locked, so mass fabrication burns real capital before a single coin is withdrawable.
